headline: Inferlupa Build
title: Inferlupa Best Build | Crossfire and Wolfpack | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Inferlupa is a Dark and Fire Breaker, and Break is its best stat. Lead with Crossfire, a skill that fires a penetrating flame ray. Use Wolfpack Onslaught as the ultimate, and take the Full Energy trait, which powers up your next skill after eight basic attacks. Watch out for Water, Wind and Light. Gracewing, Luminelle and Erlath make a good team. Do you run Inferlupa? Comment below!
